title: Flash floods hit Sungai Buloh, Puncak Alam after heavy rain (VIDEO) - Yahoo

Malay Mail KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 5 — Several areas around Puncak Alam, Selangor, were hit by flash floods this afternoon following prolonged heavy rain, leaving several roads inundated.
 Malay Mail also sighted an overflowing flood retention pond at Taman Seri Alam in Saujana Utama, Sungai Buloh, with water gushing into a nearby residential area.
 According to Harian Metro , other affected areas included Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM) Puncak Alam, Alam Suria and Jalan Meru near the Kampung Bukit Cerakah junction.
 Videos of the incident showed muddy floodwaters covering roads and a parking area near UiTM Puncak Alam, while photographs showed vehicles making their way through flooded roads.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Heavy rain reportedly continued in Puncak Alam until around 5pm.
 Vehicles travel along a road affected by flash floods at Bandar Hillpark in Puncak Alam following heavy rain on November 5, 2026. — Picture by Yusof Isa Vehicles travel along a road affected by flash floods at Bandar Hillpark in Puncak Alam following heavy rain on November 5, 2026. — Picture by Yusof Isa
 The Malaysian Meteorological Department (MetMalaysia) had forecast thunderstorms across much of Selangor this afternoon and evening, including in Kuala Selangor.
 As of the report, authorities had yet to confirm the number of people affected, road conditions or whether any emergencies had occurred.
